pages.title: Sword Flight
pages.text: Transform a held sword into a rideable flying sword and travel while standing upon its blade.$(br2)$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Activation Cost:$() 2,000 magicules$(br)$(bold)Source:$() Decipher an Ancient Book and study a Sword Flight Manual

pages.title: Deploying the Sword
pages.text: Hold a sword in either hand and press the skill key. It leaves that hand and becomes a flying sword entity. Right-click your sword to stand on and ride it.

pages.title: Flight Controls
pages.text: Use movement keys for horizontal control.$(br)$(bold)Jump:$() ascend$(br)$(bold)Sprint (Ctrl by default):$() descend$(br)$(bold)Shift:$() dismount$(br2)The sword follows its rider's facing direction and moves faster while sprinting.

pages.title: Summoning and Recalling
pages.text: Use $(bold)Shift+Right-click$() on the sword to return it to your inventory.$(br2)If an existing deployed sword is elsewhere, pressing the skill key summons it toward you.
